name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Scholarship
benefit: - The scholarship amount is provided to eligible students for education. - The scholarship was provided as per the norms of the concerned department. - Categories covered include Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, and the economically weaker general category.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant’s name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, or economically weaker general category. 1. The applicant should meet educational and income criteria prescribed under the relevant scholarship scheme.
